시편-59-1.title: 시편 59장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-1.exegesis: 10-11. wash ... wicked-- denoting great slaughter. The joy of triumph over the destruction of the wicked is because they are God's enemies, and their overthrow shows that He reigneth (compare Psa 52:5-7; 54: 7 ). In this assurance let heaven and earth rejoice ( Psa 96:10 ; 97:1 , &c.).

시편-59-2.title: 시편 59장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-2.exegesis: PSALM 59 Psa 59:1-17 . See on Psa 57:1 , title, and for history, 1Sa 19:11 , &c. The scope is very similar to that of the fifty-seventh: prayer in view of malicious and violent foes, and joy in prospect of relief. 1. defend me-- (Compare Margin). rise up ... me-- (Compare Psa 17:7 ).

시편-59-5.title: 시편 59장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-5.exegesis: 4-5. prepare, &c.-- literally, "set themselves as in array." awake-- (Compare Psa 3:7 ; 7:6 ), appeals to God in His covenant relation to His people ( Psa 9:18 ).

시편-59-7.title: 시편 59장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-7.exegesis: 6-7. They are as ravening dogs seeking prey, and as such, belch out-- that is, slanders, their impudent barkings.
시편-59-7.theologicalNote: 6-7. They are as ravening dogs seeking prey, and as such, belch out-- that is, slanders, their impudent barkings.

시편-59-10.title: 시편 59장 10절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-10.exegesis: 9. By judicious expositors, and on good grounds, this is better rendered, "O my strength, on Thee will I wait" ( Psa 59:17 ). defence-- (Compare Psa 18:3 ).
시편-59-10.theologicalNote: 9. By judicious expositors, and on good grounds, this is better rendered, "O my strength, on Thee will I wait" ( Psa 59:17 ). defence-- (Compare Psa 18:3 ).

시편-59-11.title: 시편 59장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-11.exegesis: 10. prevent me-- ( Psa 21:3 ). see my desire-- in their overthrow ( Psa 54:7 ). enemies-- as in Psa 5:8 .
시편-59-11.theologicalNote: 10. prevent me-- ( Psa 21:3 ). see my desire-- in their overthrow ( Psa 54:7 ). enemies-- as in Psa 5:8 .

시편-59-12.title: 시편 59장 12절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-12.exegesis: 11. Slay them not-- at once ( Jud 2:21-23 ); but perpetuate their punishment ( Ge 4:12 ; Nu 32:13 ), by scattering or making them wander, and humble them.
시편-59-12.theologicalNote: 11. Slay them not-- at once ( Jud 2:21-23 ); but perpetuate their punishment ( Ge 4:12 ; Nu 32:13 ), by scattering or making them wander, and humble them.

시편-59-13.title: 시편 59장 13절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-13.exegesis: 12. let them even be ... taken in their pride-- while evincing it--that is, to be punished for their lies, &c.
시편-59-13.theologicalNote: 12. let them even be ... taken in their pride-- while evincing it--that is, to be punished for their lies, &c.

시편-59-14.title: 시편 59장 14절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-14.exegesis: 13. Though delayed for wise reasons, the utter destruction of the wicked must come at last, and God's presence and power in and for His Church will be known abroad ( 1Sa 17:46 ; Psa 46:10 , 11 ).
시편-59-14.theologicalNote: 13. Though delayed for wise reasons, the utter destruction of the wicked must come at last, and God's presence and power in and for His Church will be known abroad ( 1Sa 17:46 ; Psa 46:10 , 11 ).

시편-59-15.title: 시편 59장 15절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-15.exegesis: 14-15. Meanwhile let the rapacious dogs prowl, they cannot hurt the pious; yea, they shall wander famished and sleepless.
시편-59-15.theologicalNote: 14-15. Meanwhile let the rapacious dogs prowl, they cannot hurt the pious; yea, they shall wander famished and sleepless.

시편-59-17.title: 시편 59장 17절 역사문법적 주해
시편-59-17.exegesis: 16-17. Contrast the lot of God's servant, who employs his time in God's praise. sing aloud ... in the morning-- when they retire famishing and disappointed, or it may denote delightful diligence in praise, as in Psa 30:5 .
